text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick FYI  Morgan (Eng Manager) starts Mon 09:30 PT. Dropping a compact orientation checklist + suggested first-week rhythm. Please ack the pieces you own by EOD Fri.

Maya (People Ops): Day-before essentials (short bullets):
- laptop + charger shipped and tracked
- Okta + MFA invite sent
- Slack + email + calendar provisioned
- Notion access to /team/eng/managers + hiring folder
- 1Password manager vault access granted
- welcome email with one-page "week 1 expectations" sent

Zoe (People Ops): I'll send the welcome email and the short 1:1 note template. Also queue mandatory trainings (security + data handling).

Riley (IT): Device ordered (MacBook Pro). Imaging in progress. Will install dev image, Docker, VSCode, VPN and add to eng-dev. Question: add Concur now or after payroll?

Maya (People Ops): Wait until payroll confirms, then Concur + petty cash if needed. We'll do budget access after 30d.

Ethan (Eng): I can buddy week 1. I'll run infra + repo walkthrough and add a tiny first-PR onboarding task. Also propose a 20m "team norms" slot Tue morning.

Maya (People Ops): Nice. Minimal week-1 manager rhythm we recommend (copyable):
Mon 09:30 quick ops + welcome (10m), 10:00 team kickoff (30m), 15:00 1:1 w/ director (30m)
Tue buddy shadow + infra walkthrough (60m) + team norms (20m)
Wed product context + PM intro (30m)
Thu draft 30/60/90 + hiring rubric review (45m)
Fri skip-level cafe + week1 retro (30m)

Maya (People Ops): 30/60/90 primers (one-line each):
- 30d: meet team, learn code paths, ship a docs/infra onboarding win
- 60d: lead a planning session, propose two small improvements to process/infra
- 90d: own a roadmap slice and hiring/mentorship plan

Zoe (People Ops): Who-to-ask cheat-sheet (micro):
- payroll & comp: Zoe
- hardware & accounts: Riley
- infra & cluster access: Ethan / #platform-eng
- security/compliance: #eng-security

onboard-bot: Reminder created: "Morgan - prestart checklist" Fri 17:00 PT.

Riley (IT): :white_check_mark: Device imaged & shipping label created. Will DM tracking when scanned.

Ethan (Eng): :white_check_mark: Buddy + first-PR task ready. I'll add the team norms slot.

Zoe (People Ops): :white_check_mark: Welcome email + trainings queued. 1:1 template added to Notion.

Morgan (new-manager): Thanks team  appreciate the clarity. Quick Q: can I get the hiring rubric and the repo links before Thu so I can draft my 30/60/90?

Ethan (Eng): Linking hiring rubric and core repo readme to the Notion page now.

Maya (People Ops): Great. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your items are done so I can close the checklist. I'll publish the consolidated Notion page and DM Morgan the week-1 calendar + links.
